source_review.identity: Printed 000 XM381 and LM REG TO XY REG BITS 36-37-38 VIA MIXER match the source filename and title block.
source_review.coverage: Inspected full native overview and UTF-8 preview, plus enlarged native crops for all three receivers, the two 0500 three-gate mixers, the 0505 four-gate mixer, format junctions, external references, output branches and footer.
key_findings: The bit 36, 37 and 38 AR/N receivers keep separate positive and negative destinations, including the XM395 negative LM rails.
The 0500 A1-A3 and OR groups represent bits 36 and 37, while the 0505 A1-A4 and OR/R group represents bit 38. Their XX391 outputs and branch designations match native source.
Enlarged junction traces confirm FMTN-0-1 to AO.B09, AL.B08 and AS.D04; FMTN-6 to AP.D12, AM.D05 and AT.B04; and FMT0-0-1-2 LINE E to AN.B12, AK.D06 and AR.D06. Plain rail crossings remain separate.
Left source references, positive output destination lists, footer connector legend, dates and physical locations match the native scan.
